description: This file contains Redux action creators for handling contact form interactions in a React/Redux application, including form state updates and submitting contact data via an API call.

methods.name: contactFormChange
methods.description: Action creator to handle changes in contact form fields, updating the Redux store with the new value for a given field.

methods.name: contactUs
methods.description: Async action creator that validates contact form data, submits it via an API call, and handles success or error responses.
